Are Kundali Milan and Relationship ready?

Long image

A

Answer

Matching and the solo marriage reading are real and mostly Gold-gated. Four high gaps still block “good”: Expand print leaks Gold, dual Save confuses users, print is thinner than the UI, and coach copy still reaches clients.

  1. Product split is clear: Relationship is one chart; Milan is two charts on /compare.
  2. Gold gates for Match-Making, Married Life, All Sections, and header print match SUBSCRIPTION_MATRIX.md.
  3. Free Expand print and muhurta still leak paid paths.
  4. Engines for karma and Venus marriage sit tested but unused in UI.

Applies toLive code auditOct 2026no product change

  1. Gate Expand print + muhurta ↗

    Hide Expand print unless Gold; stop Free gochar fetch.

  2. Rename or unify Saves ↗

    Label Expand “Save on this device” or push to Mongo when signed in.

  3. Grow or rename PDF ↗

    Add case brief, pillars detail, dual columns — or call it a summary.

  4. Client-safe engine voice ↗

    Drop principles blobs from default view; keep coach behind Client-safe off.

  5. Dual remaining Rel tabs ↗

    Port 7th-axis, combinations, Ju–Ma–Sa notes into Milan Married Life.

  6. Wire or drop karma / Venus ↗

    Use in Bond tabs or delete unused modules.

  7. Suite + API security tests ↗

    Cover timing, dual Jaimini, milan save ownership, gochar Gold.
